title: Home prepares a table on request, step by step, asking before a step drops many rows, and never touching the original
request: The owner's goal: Home serves people who want data manipulation, not only models. Plan H9: typed steps (rename to sort, join, pivot, derive), each previewed, logged, undoable and applied to a new table; a guard that asks before a step removes over 5% of rows or a join changes the row count; export as CSV, Parquet or Excel. Done when every H1 preparation request produces the expected table, trap 3 is caught, and the original file is untouched.
spec: H9a: dclab_core.recipe (Step, StepPreview, Recipe v1, run, preview, apply, undo, the guard) and Home's side: rules reading steps from the person's sentence (English and Persian), each previewed in order, a guarded step asked as confirm_step (yes applies; no or not sure skips), the result written as prepared.parquet beside the untouched original, downloadable as CSV, Excel or Parquet. The model's tools (propose_step, apply_step, undo_step, export_data) are H9b.
plan: dclab_core/recipe.py with tests on each H1 dev preparation request against pandas.
draft/prepare.py: steps from words; values looked up in the table by code.
Home: prepare_table, confirm_step, the download route; the exit 'dataset' reached.

decisions.decision: A guarded step is skipped on 'not sure'.
decisions.why: Dropping rows is never the default: only a yes removes them.

decisions.decision: Every upload keeps its own cleaned copy beside clean.parquet.
decisions.why: Each upload overwrote clean.parquet, so a join's first table was gone by the time the second arrived.

decisions.decision: A value named in words ('paid') is found in the table by code.
decisions.why: No cell value goes to a model; the rules read the column that holds it.

decisions.decision: Words the rules cannot read are said, never guessed.
decisions.why: A guessed step would change the person's table without their words behind it.

change: dclab_core/recipe.py (new, dclab-core 0.129.0); dclab_rnd/draft/prepare.py (new); draft/chat.py (prepare_table, confirm_step, _other_tables, routing); draft/api.py (GET prepared); draft/pipeline.py (a kept copy per upload); draft/exits.py ('dataset' built); draft/intent.py (the preparation line); agent_eval/home (a recipe's numbers count as code-computed); tests. dclab_core/ledger.py (recipe.step; state field step_kind); ledger/capture.py (recipe_step_answered); ledger/__init__.py (CAPTURED); views/home.html (download buttons).

findings.defect: A join could not find its second table.
findings.scenario: Orders and customers uploaded: 'I could not read the steps' twice, no prepared table.
findings.cause: Every upload wrote the same clean.parquet, overwriting the first table; and Home tried before the second table arrived.
findings.fix: A kept copy per upload (same bytes, same hash); a join waits for its second table, said once.

findings.defect: The guard question's numbers were counted as uncited.
findings.scenario: 'removes 1,687 of 2,000 rows (84%)' had no source once the question was answered.
findings.cause: The pending entry with the preview was cleared after the answer.
findings.fix: Each guarded question is kept in the recipe with its preview numbers.

findings.defect: Persian 'rows without an amount' was not read.
findings.scenario: 'ردیف‌هایی که مبلغ ندارند حذف کن' gave only the date step.
findings.cause: Normalizing turns the zero-width joiner into a space, so 'ردیف‌هایی' became two words.
findings.fix: The pattern allows the plural suffix as its own word.

findings.defect: A no was taken as a yes.
findings.scenario: 'اعمال نکن' (don't apply) applied a step that removed 95% of the rows; 'ok no' and 'yes but only 2025' too.
findings.cause: Only the reply's start was read.
findings.fix: Only a whole yes with no negation applies; a whole no or 'not sure' skips.

findings.defect: A negation turned a filter into its opposite.
findings.scenario: 'Keep only the orders that are not cancelled' became status = cancelled, asked in the person's own words.
findings.cause: Value words were looked up; 'not' was left as an unread word.
findings.fix: A negation leaves the whole phrase unread; the question says the filter as read.

findings.defect: A year was dropped while the value filter stayed.
findings.scenario: Two date columns: 'paid orders from 2026' kept every year.
findings.cause: The year was skipped when no single date column was found; 'updated_at' counted as a date name; 'top 2000' read as a year.
findings.fix: A year needs 'from/in/of YYYY' and one date column, or the whole phrase is unread.

findings.defect: The join added to the wrong table.
findings.scenario: Orders then customers uploaded: customers joined with orders, 1,200 rows became 2,198.
findings.cause: The last upload was the main table; the test uploaded in reverse.
findings.fix: The main table is the one where the key repeats; tested in the natural order.

findings.defect: Any other message while asked was a skip.
findings.scenario: 'Actually I want to predict which orders get refunded' skipped the step and wrote the table.
findings.fix: A reply that is not a yes or no closes the question undecided and is read as a message.

findings.defect: Home invited a reply it never read.
findings.scenario: 'Say them one at a time' then 'remove duplicate orders' gave 'Noted.'
findings.cause: Steps were read from the first sentence only.
findings.fix: Steps are read from the reply Home invited, or the answer to 'What should I do to the data?'.

findings.defect: The export could not be reached.
findings.cause: make web not run; no page rendering.
findings.fix: Download buttons in the format asked, through DC.client.href.preparedTable.
findings.test: tests/test_web_client.py; checked on the real server

findings.defect: A pivot took columns in the order said.
findings.scenario: 'pivot the sum of amount per region by product_category' made amount the rows.
findings.cause: Column names were taken by position.
findings.fix: Each column by its role words; a sum or mean of text is refused.

findings.defect: Most of the preparation was not captured for training.
findings.scenario: Only counts were recorded; the person's yes or no to the guard was nowhere.
findings.cause: moved kept counts; no ledger point.
findings.fix: moved keeps each step's kind and column names and what was applied; recipe.step in the ledger, labelled by the person's answer.

findings.defect: The prepared file could overwrite an upload and was not in file storage; a finished exit could lose 'reached'.
findings.scenario: An upload named prepared.parquet; S3 storage; leaving the track and coming back.
findings.cause: One shared name; no _record; route() knew only analysis and ml_project.
findings.fix: prepared__<asset>.parquet, recorded; dataset reached while the recipe is done.

findings.defect: 'combine first and last name' waited for a second table for ever.

findings.scenario: A text cell '=HYPERLINK(...)' opens as a live formula.
findings.fix: Text cells starting = + - @ are written as text.

measurements.name: Home on the H1 dev requests (rules alone)
measurements.gate: trap 3 caught, no uncited number, no wrong field
measurements.result: Traps 6 of 6 (5 before: 'keep only the paid orders from 2026' now waits for a yes); exits 36 of 36; fields 65 right, 0 wrong; uncited 0

measurements.name: Each H1 dev preparation request makes the expected table
measurements.gate: equal to pandas computed by hand; the original file's hash unchanged
measurements.result: d-r1 to d-r6 pass through Home (the join with its second table); d-p6 is a prediction first
limits: the dev requests' own wording; other wordings fall to 'say it in steps' until the model's tools (H9b)

measurements.name: The page on the real server
measurements.gate: the guard question says the filter as read; a yes makes the table; the Excel download works
measurements.result: 'keep only the rows where order_date from 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31 and status = paid: it removes 300 of 400 rows (75%)'; after Yes, 100 rows; Excel 200
limits: by hand in the built-in browser

outcome: A person who wants their data cleaned, filtered, joined or reshaped gets a new table in the format they asked for, with each step and its row counts listed, a yes asked before many rows go, and their original file untouched.
lessons: A shared file name is a hidden overwrite: give each input its own copy before anything joins them.
A yes/no reader must read the whole reply: a guard is only as strong as its weakest 'yes'.
Ask in the words of what will happen, not the words the person used: they confirm what they meant, not what was read.
risks: The rules read the dev wordings and their close variants only; H9b's tools serve the rest.
A large table is prepared in the request, not as a job yet.
